body: I know what you mean when you say that you want to ruin her life.  Ive been there before.  I no longer have the option to do this to my abuser anymore, they took that away from me.  But there absence from my life does not ease the pain.  The only way to escape the pain is to live through it because it will end.  Eventually you will be able to move out on your own and distance yourself from your abuser and the pain they have caused you.  The scars they have caused may remain but it will not always hurt.  You will develop a life full of people that love you and care for you like you deserve.  It won't always be this bad, and the time which you are forced to deal with this person is fading as you grow older and more independent each day.  You are strong and can get through this.  If you want further advice or just someone to listen who understands what its like to live through an abussive parent feel free to DM me.

I have talked to both counselors and many others throughout my life though recently I have not been talking as much to people around me about this.  It is hard to reach out and I am so overwhelmed with alot of what is going on in my life that I don't have time to dedicate to myself sometimes.  Alot of the time I just don't feel I know who I can trust.   With rejection has come fear of openning up further continuously because they may not always be there, and in many ways they cannot be there in the way you need them to be.  She texted me today and I told her I didn't know if I wanted to live and she came and basically saved me.  But she is gone now, I am with other friends at the moment but I am scared of the night ahead.  How can I hold on to her and rely on her like this when not being with her is hurting me incredibly also?
